No installation sweep, adhesion or fit is claimed

The adopted battery envelope is 38 mm wide while the photo-traced slotted-flange inner gap is 35 mm; the V40 panel shows the battery snug between the tabs, so the traced gap is slightly narrow. The resulting interference is declared and bounded to at most 2 mm depth on every face, not hidden
Hook and loop tape are zero-solid; the adhesion contact is the touching top face and carries no strength, fit or safety claim
The battery is an external tutorial envelope with no capacity, voltage or safety claim; its integral lead is a zero-solid schematic
The battery lead's HAT-end connector frame is not established, so the connect operation of this step stays BLOCKED until the Robot HAT battery connector has a source-backed frame
No installation sweep or fit is claimed

The pan horn is the additive instructional revision of the supplied long double-arm horn (34 mm tip to tip, tapered arms, 7.7 mm hub, 12 attachment holes at a derived 2.1 mm pitch); V40 S08 and S13 draw a two-sided horn with screws on both sides of the hub, and the printed package shows two long double-arm horns and one single-arm horn, so pan and tilt take the double-arm and steering the single-arm. The large and small cross horns are unused spare stock. Dimensions are DERIVED to about 2 to 6 percent from penny-scaled photographs; spline form, hub recess and thread geometry are not modelled

The four deck screws sit in the traced deck holes, which agree with the derived horn hole row only to within about 0.9 mm; each screw therefore has a scoped overlap with solid horn plate beside the hole, and no screw-to-horn-hole alignment is claimed

Deck small-hole rows are photo-traced (four on one side, three on the other) and are not manufacturer positions; the 1.4 mm holes are smaller than the 1.5 mm screws, so each screw has a declared small clearance overlap with the deck
The accepted ordered stack for this step lists the horn before the plate, which is not the physical order shown in V40; it is used for membership only
Pan zero angle and horn clocking about the hub are not established; the arm is placed symmetrically across the car as a presentation gauge
No installation sweep, thread engagement or fit is claimed

The module is the additive instructional revision derived from the supplied-hardware photographs: a 46.2 x 20.5 mm board, transducer cans 28.4 mm apart and 1.6 mm off the board centre line toward the crystal edge, a crystal on that edge and a 4-pin connector on the rear of the opposite edge. Values are DERIVED to about 2 to 6 percent, not manufacturer verified; the exact OEM identity and revision stay unresolved and the 5 V versus V40 3V3 conflict stays open
The traced wall openings are 30 mm apart and the cans 28.4 mm apart, so each can sits 0.8 mm off its opening centre with 0.4 mm of radial slack; this is a derived relation, not a measured fit

The connector edge is placed down because a connector-up board would put its connector about 5 mm into the deck; V40 does not show the connector, and the rear connector passing through the Plate H notch (notch 14.3 mm, connector about 14.0 mm) is a derived coincidence, not a source-stated relation

Plate H is the additive instructional revision: its photographed outline is about 20.5 mm tall with a notch about 5.2 mm deep, against 23.14 mm and 6.36 mm in the accepted M6 outline; the M6 hole centres, notch width and notch floor are kept, and the end-hole axes remain the rivet axes
Rear integrated circuits and passives of the module, about 1.3 to 1.8 mm tall, are not represented, so Plate H is shown resting on the board rear face
The rivets pass beside the module ends, so the module is held between wall and H plate by clamping, not by its own corner holes
The rivet proxy shows only its unlocked body with the pin lifted; the locked pin state is not represented, and no rivet strength, grip range or retention is claimed
The accepted ordered stack lists the module before the wall, which is not the physical order shown in V40; it is used for membership only
No installation sweep or fit is claimed
